verdict.rationale: The Cactus engine README lists 'OpenAI-compatible APIs for text, speech, and vision,' which signals some image-plus-text model support. That is the only mention, though: no supported VLM is named, and image input is not documented. Converting arbitrary HuggingFace models, which might cover VLMs, is explicitly labelled experimental. Missing for 10: named supported vision-language models, documentation of image input usage and API, hands-on or independent corroboration of image understanding, and evidence of mobile/on-device VLM performance.
